title: Documentary project with secret dating evidence

tellings.quote: I am part of a very significant documentary that I'm leading

plain: Matt LaCroix, who studies ancient sites, says that in 2024 he was leading 'a very significant documentary' with new dating evidence, still kept secret, from sites in Turkey, Peru, Bolivia and Minorca. He tells Michels about it himself and names others in the project, among them Robert Schoch and Robert Edward Grant. If the evidence is what he hints, it would push some of these sites much further back in time.
